CLM-MAT-0185.statement: The calculated band gap of the conventional 2D h-BN phase is 4.7 eV.

extra_quotes: In this paper first-principle calculations were carried out by using Quantum Espresso software ( Giannozzi et al. 2009) .

We employed the standard solid state pseudo-potential library (SSSP: precision, version 2.0 (Pradini et al. 2021)) with the exchange-correlation energy given in Perdew–Burke–Ernzerhof (PBE) form (Perdew et al. 1996).
